runs.final_sql: SELECT unit_msr.nm FROM bom JOIN unit_msr ON bom.ref1 = unit_msr.unt_msr_cd WHERE bom.end_dt IS NULL AND bom.ref2 = 494

SELECT prod_vnd.avrg_ld_tm, vnd.nm
FROM po_hdr
JOIN po_dtl ON po_hdr.prch_ordr_id = po_dtl.ref2
JOIN prod_vnd ON po_dtl.ref1 = prod_vnd.ref3
JOIN vnd ON prod_vnd.ref2 = vnd.ref1
WHERE po_hdr.ref2 = 1496

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN addr.cty = 'Bothell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN addr.cty = 'Kenmore' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff, st_prv.nm AS state_name FROM cust JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = COALESCE(cust.ref3, cust.ref1) JOIN addr ON addr.addr_id = biz_addr.ref3 JOIN st_prv ON st_prv.stt_prvn_id = addr.ref1 WHERE addr.cty IN ('Bothell', 'Kenmore') GROUP BY st_prv.nm

SELECT v.nm, pv.stnd_prc
FROM prod_vnd pv
JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
JOIN prod p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
WHERE p.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1) AS cnt
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE p.eml_prmt = 0
  AND d.nm = 'Engineering'

WITH latest_pay AS (
    SELECT ref1, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC, mdfd_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN latest_pay lp ON lp.ref1 = e.ref1 AND lp.rn = 1
WHERE e.jb_ttl = 'Production Technician'
  AND lp.rt < (
      SELECT AVG(lp2.rt)
      FROM emp e2
      JOIN latest_pay lp2 ON lp2.ref1 = e2.ref1 AND lp2.rn = 1
      WHERE e2.jb_ttl = 'Production Technician'
  )

SELECT s.strt_tm, s.end_tm
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN shft AS s ON edh.ref1 = s.shft_id
WHERE YEAR(e.brth_dt) < 1969
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 5, 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref1)
FROM prsn p
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON p.ref1 = pc.ref1
JOIN crd c ON pc.ref2 = c.crdt_crd_id
WHERE p.prsn_typ = 'SC' AND c.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT d.nm, AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(e.brth_dt)) AS avg_age
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.nm
ORDER BY avg_age ASC

SELECT AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(emp.hr_dt)) AS average_length
FROM emp
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
WHERE dept.nm = 'Research and Development'
  AND emp_dept_hist.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT SUM(po_dtl.ordr_qty) / COUNT(shp_mth.shp_mthd_id) AS avg_total_ordered_quantity
FROM po_dtl
JOIN po_hdr ON po_dtl.ref2 = po_hdr.prch_ordr_id
JOIN shp_mth ON po_hdr.ref1 = shp_mth.shp_mthd_id
WHERE shp_mth.nm = 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) AS department_count FROM prsn p JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON p.ref1 = edh.ref3 WHERE p.frst_nm = 'Sheela' AND p.lst_nm = 'Word' AND edh.strt_dt <= '2012-12-31' AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2011-01-01')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.dprt_id) AS department_count
FROM prsn p
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON p.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE p.frst_nm = 'David' AND p.lst_nm = 'Bradley'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1)
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Information Services'
  AND s.nm = 'Evening'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1)
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering'
  AND edh.strt_dt <= '2009-12-31'
  AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2009-01-01')

SELECT ((MAX(p.lst_prc) - MIN(p.lst_prc)) / MIN(p.lst_prc)) * 100 AS percentage_more_expensive
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref1 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref2) FROM so_dtl WHERE ordr_qty > 2 AND unt_prc_dscn > 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref2
WHERE pv.mn_ordr_qty = 1000
  AND p.stnd_cst > 17

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.hr_dt
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM emp_dept_hist edh
  WHERE edh.ref1 = e.ref1
    AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, 2022 - YEAR(e.brth_dt) + 1 AS age
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE edh.ref3 = 3
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.mddl_nm, prsn.lst_nm, prsn.ttl, prsn.sffx
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_pay_hist.ref1
WHERE emp.mrtl_stts = 'M'
ORDER BY emp_pay_hist.rt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT d.nm
FROM prsn p
JOIN emp e ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE p.frst_nm = 'David'
  AND p.lst_nm = 'Bradley'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT v.nm
FROM prod AS p
JOIN prod_vnd AS pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3
JOIN vnd AS v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
WHERE p.prdc_nmbr = 'WB-H098'

SELECT AVG(lp.rt)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT edh.ref3 AS emp_id
    FROM emp_dept_hist edh
    JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
    WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering'
      AND YEAR(edh.strt_dt) <= 2007
      AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR YEAR(edh.end_dt) >= 2007)
) AS eng_emp
JOIN (
    SELECT eph1.ref1, eph1.rt
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph1
    WHERE eph1.rt_chng_dt = (
        SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
        FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
        WHERE eph2.ref1 = eph1.ref1
    )
) AS lp ON eng_emp.emp_id = lp.ref1
SELECT SUM(wo.stck_qty) FROM wo WHERE wo.wrk_ordr_id IN (SELECT wo_rtg.ref2 FROM wo_rtg WHERE wo_rtg.ref1 = 40)

SELECT edh.end_dt
FROM emp
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON emp.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE emp.jb_ttl = 'Senior Tool Designer'
  AND YEAR(emp.hr_dt) - YEAR(emp.brth_dt) = 33
  AND dept.nm = 'Engineering'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT addr.addr_ln1, addr.addr_ln2, addr.cty, addr.pstl_cd
FROM prsn
JOIN biz_addr ON prsn.ref1 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN addr_typ ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr_typ.addr_typ_id
WHERE prsn.ref1 = 5555 AND addr_typ.nm = 'Home'

SELECT DISTINCT pm.nm
FROM prod_mdl pm
JOIN pmdc ON pmdc.ref3 = pm.prdc_mdl_id
JOIN prod_dsc pd ON pd.prdc_dscr_id = pmdc.ref2
JOIN cult c ON c.cltr_id = pmdc.ref1
WHERE c.nm = 'English'
  AND pd.dscr LIKE '%AdventureWorks%'
  AND pm.ctlg_dscr LIKE '%chromoly steel%'

SELECT d.nm
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref1 = s.shft_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Night'
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nm
FROM emp_dept_hist AS edh
JOIN dept AS d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN shft AS s ON s.shft_id = edh.ref3
WHERE s.nm = 'Evening'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm FROM emp_dept_hist edh JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id JOIN prsn p ON edh.ref3 = p.ref1 WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering' ORDER BY DATEDIFF(edh.end_dt, edh.strt_dt) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.nm
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3
JOIN vnd v ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
WHERE p.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'
ORDER BY pv.stnd_prc ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN biz_cnt ON stor.ref2 = biz_cnt.ref3
JOIN prsn ON biz_cnt.ref1 = prsn.ref1
WHERE stor.nm = 'Next-Door Bike Store'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON e.ref1 = eph.ref1
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) l ON eph.ref1 = l.ref1 AND eph.rt_chng_dt = l.max_rt_chng_dt
WHERE e.mrtl_stts = 'S' AND e.gndr = 'F'
ORDER BY eph.rt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM emp
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
WHERE dept.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND YEAR(emp.hr_dt) = 2009
GROUP BY emp.ref1, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm

SELECT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, sls_terr.nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref1
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref2 = sls_terr.trrt_id
WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, a.pstl_cd
FROM prod_vnd pv
JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1
JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
WHERE pv.ref3 = 843

WITH latest_pay AS (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
)
SELECT edh.ref2 AS DepartmentID, AVG(eph.rt) AS AverageHourlyPayRate
FROM emp_pay_hist eph
JOIN latest_pay lp ON eph.ref1 = lp.ref1 AND eph.rt_chng_dt = lp.max_dt
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON eph.ref1 = edh.ref3
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY edh.ref2

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm, bt.lvl
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id)
FROM cust AS c
JOIN prsn_crd AS pc ON c.ref3 = pc.ref1
JOIN so_hdr AS so ON c.cstm_id = so.ref8
WHERE YEAR(so.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, SUM(s.ttl_due) AS total_order_value
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn p ON c.ref3 = p.ref1
JOIN so_hdr s ON c.accn_nmbr = s.accn_nmbr
WHERE c.ref3 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.cstm_id, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
ORDER BY total_order_value DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so_hdr.sls_ordr_id)
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = COALESCE(cust.ref3, cust.ref1)
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
JOIN cnty ON st_prv.ref2 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013
  AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(soh.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM sls_prsn sp
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = sp.ref1
LEFT JOIN so_hdr soh ON soh.ref7 = sp.ref1
  AND soh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND soh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
GROUP BY sp.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
ORDER BY order_count

SELECT d.nm AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) AS headcount
FROM dept d
LEFT JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY headcount

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) AS department_count
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
GROUP BY e.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) > 1

SELECT v.nm AS vendor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.ref3) AS product_count
FROM vnd v
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
GROUP BY v.ref1, v.nm
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT v.nm, COUNT(p.prch_ordr_id) AS purchase_order_count
FROM vnd v
LEFT JOIN po_hdr p ON v.ref1 = p.ref2
GROUP BY v.ref1, v.nm
ORDER BY purchase_order_count DESC

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm
SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm FROM stor JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = stor.ref2 JOIN addr ON addr.addr_id = biz_addr.ref3 JOIN st_prv ON st_prv.stt_prvn_id = addr.ref1 ORDER BY stor.nm
